title: sambucus microbotrys xanthocarpa
intro: Sambucus microbotrys xanthocarpa, commonly known as elderberry, is a plant species in the Adoxaceae family, known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. It has been used to alleviate various health issues, including colds, flu, and sinus infections, due to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of elderberry include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, making it a popular natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of elderberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
